Both teams rank high in time of possession. Louisiana is 6th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 33:33, while South Alabama's 15th-ranked average is 32:48. Team leaders Louisiana Passing: D'Wayne Winfield, 1,452 yards, 6 TDs, 5 INTs, 66.8 completion percentage Rushing: Winfield, 470 yards on 110 carries, 9 TDs Receiving: KeDarius Wade, 279 yards on 13 catches, 2 TDs South Alabama Passing: Jared Hollins, 1,195 yards, 9 TDs, 4 INTs, 52.6 completion percentage Rushing: Keenan Phillips, 576 yards on 107 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Brendan Jenkins, 451 yards on 27 catches, 3 TDs Last game Louisiana fell to Southern Miss 35-31 on Oct. 24. Garner had 52 rushing yards on seven carries and one touchdown, adding two receptions for 13 yards. Shelton Sampson Jr. put up 58 yards on five catches. South Alabama was beaten by Louisiana Tech 35-20 on Oct. 31. Hollins passed for 192 yards on 14-of-31 attempts (45.2%) with two touchdowns and one interception.
